host.label: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the obs-websocket server.

password_file.label: Password file
password_file.description: Path to a file containing the obs-websocket password, read at request time. Leave empty for an unauthenticated connection.

obs_cli_path.label: obs-cli path
obs_cli_path.description: Path to the obs-cli executable, if not on PATH.

obs_control_path.label: obs-control path
obs_control_path.description: Path to the obs-control executable, if not on PATH.

mic_input_name.label: Microphone input name
mic_input_name.description: obs-websocket input name to target for mute status/toggling. Leave empty to mute all PulseAudio/PipeWire sources through obs-control instead.

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: How often to poll OBS for scene, recording, streaming, and virtual camera status.

bar_max_scene_length.label: Max scene name length
bar_max_scene_length.description: Truncate the scene name in the bar past this many characters.

bar_show_rec_indicator.label: Show REC indicator
bar_show_rec_indicator.description: Show a blinking red dot in the bar while recording.

bar_show_stream_indicator.label: Show stream indicator
bar_show_stream_indicator.description: Show a broadcast glyph in the bar while streaming.

animations_enabled.label: Enable animations
animations_enabled.description: Blink the REC indicator while recording.

action_left_click.label: Left click
action_left_click.description: Action for a left click on the bar widget.

action_right_click.label: Right click
action_right_click.description: Action for a right click on the bar widget.

action_middle_click.label: Middle click
action_middle_click.description: Action for a middle click on the bar widget.

action_scroll_up.label: Scroll up
action_scroll_up.description: Action for scrolling up on the bar widget.

action_scroll_down.label: Scroll down
action_scroll_down.description: Action for scrolling down on the bar widget.

action.description: Action for this bar widget interaction.

panel_show_scene_list.label: Show scene list
panel_show_scene_list.description: Show the scene switcher in the panel.

panel_show_quick_actions.label: Show quick actions
panel_show_quick_actions.description: Show the record/stream/virtual camera/mute row in the panel.

custom_buttons_columns.label: Custom button columns
custom_buttons_columns.description: How many custom buttons per row.

bar_icon_size.label: Icon size
bar_icon_size.description: Size of the bar icon in pixels.

bar_spacing.label: Spacing
bar_spacing.description: Gap between bar widget elements in pixels.
